note: Private RV park on a 54-acre plantation off US-19 north of Thomasville (Ochlocknee address); serves overnight travellers plus snowbirds and seasonal/permanent residents, some in park-model homes. Sites along three stocked fishing ponds; clubhouses for rallies; park cabins for rent. --Claude
summary: Operator site live, phone (229) 227-1451 matches. Fees set (were unset; note said $35): $40/night incl. electric on the rates page (modified Aug 2026), Sunday $15 with 2 full nights, $400/month + electric. Confirmed 121 sites, sewer, laundry/showers/Wi-Fi. Amperage and water not stated (water left derived); no online booking (phone/register on arrival), so booking left alone. Map and imagery put RV sites along the ponds, consistent with the stored 'pond' call. Note cleaned ($35 dropped as wrong; year-round/hookups/WiFi/laundry dropped as field facts).
flags: GATE: $40/night posted by the operator (page modified 2026-08-27), under US$50; Good Sam Park (directory isGsPark; the park map carries the Good Sam Park logo) -> $36 at 10% off. No gateway needed; family has not stayed. Presence passes (live website + phone).

LONG-STAY / RESIDENTIAL (tests 4-5 for a human): the operator 'specialize[s] in accommodating both the individual travelers who are just passing through as well as the seasonal and permanent residents'; the rules page is written for residents of 'home lots' with park-model homes that must be blocked, anchored and skirted within 30 days, owner-occupancy only, and lets a resident 'sell his or her home and leave it in the park' to a buyer approved by the manager. Test 2 passes ($40 nightly posted + phone); the share of sites sold nightly is not stated (test 4 unmeasured). The park itself does not advertise homes for sale (Dreamland was dropped for selling homes).

PIN: stored 30.94970,-84.02654 is on McMillan Rd at the park's south edge; the site rows and ponds run ~100-400 m north (centre about 30.9512,-84.0265, ~170 m) - under the 250 m threshold, optional move.
